roadmap.title: Warring States (1572 CE)
roadmap.description: Clear the opening missions, unlock the Eternal Rift and its blacksmith, learn the combat system, defeat the first Crucible and masters, and start collecting Kodama, Hot Springs, Myth, and Chijiko as you explore.

roadmap.title: Heian (1190 CE)
roadmap.description: Push the story through Mount Kurama and the capital, complete the blacksmith memory Myth, shoot the crows in Black Feather Sanctuary, and keep clearing region collectibles to raise Exploration Level.

roadmap.title: Antiquity (247 CE)
roadmap.description: Finish the short Antiquity chapter, reach character level 100 naturally, and use the region's Hot Spring for the Distant Memories chain.

roadmap.title: Bakumatsu (1864 CE) and Final Battle of Edo
roadmap.description: Complete the last region and the final Crucible, finish the veteran master missions, the secret demon bosses' requirements, and the remaining story and combat achievements.

roadmap.title: Base-game cleanup
roadmap.description: Backtrack for all remaining collectibles, masters, demon bosses, and Myths using Exploration Level 4 map markers and Battle Scroll replay; finish the Dung Ball trade last.

roadmap.title: Hell Rising DLC (1651 CE)
roadmap.description: Play the Keian-era DLC story, its Myths, masters, collectibles, and endgame systems; purify Picture Scrolls, complete the Ueno Crucible wind kill, and finish Mountain Keep in the Storm's Eye with NPC allies.

roadmap.title: Shogun's Journey and Enlightened One's Journey
roadmap.description: Clear the DLC on Shogun's Journey to unlock Enlightened One's Journey, then complete Mountain Keep in the Storm's Eye again and nullify a cursed enemy there for the final achievements.

achievements.description: Unlocked all achievements.
achievements.summary: Earn every other achievement in Nioh 3, including all Hell Rising DLC achievements.

guide.context: The base game contains 51 achievements and the Hell Rising DLC adds 13 more. Two DLC achievements require the Enlightened One's Journey difficulty, which unlocks only after a Shogun's Journey playthrough.

steps.text: Unlock every other achievement in the base game and the Hell Rising DLC; this achievement unlocks with the last one.

achievements.description: Completed all Myths.
achievements.summary: Complete all 39 Myths, including the two that are hidden rather than marked: Yokai Horde Picture Scroll in Heian and Seeking Rare Yokai in Bakumatsu.

guide.context: Myths are the open-world side quests. Every Myth appears on the map automatically except the two hidden ones, which must be found by exploring before this achievement can complete.

steps.text: Complete every Myth in Warring States, Heian, Antiquity, and Bakumatsu; the last one finishes the set.

achievements.description: Reached level 10.
achievements.summary: Reach character level 10.

steps.text: Collect @mechanic{Amrita} from enemies and choose @mechanic{Level Up} at any Shrine until your character level reaches 10.

achievements.description: Reached level 100.
achievements.summary: Reach character level 100.

guide.context: Leveling happens naturally as the story progresses and typically lands around Main Region 3: Antiquity. Later regions give Amrita quickly, so no dedicated farming is needed.

steps.text: Play through the story and spend @mechanic{Amrita} at Shrines until your character level reaches 100.

achievements.description: Travel through time for the first time.
achievements.summary: Finish the opening mission, The Fall of Edo Castle, to travel through time for the first time.

steps.text: Complete the first story mission, @loc{The Fall of Edo Castle}.

achievements.description: Receive the Guiding Mirror from Ii Naotora.
achievements.summary: After Crucible Manifested, speak to Ii Naotora to receive the Guiding Mirror.

guide.context: This conversation follows the first Crucible and its boss Yakotsu-baba, so it happens automatically on the story path.

steps.text: Clear @loc{Crucible Manifested} and beat the boss @enemy{Yakotsu-baba}.
Speak to @npc{Ii Naotora} and accept the @item{Guiding Mirror}.

achievements.description: Destroy the Crucinite harbored within Takeda Shingen's Guardian Spirit.
achievements.summary: Defeat Takeda Shingen at the end of Tiger's Cause and destroy the Crucinite inside his Guardian Spirit.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Tiger's Cause}, which closes out Warring States, and defeat @enemy{Takeda Shingen}.

achievements.description: Destroy the Crucinite harbored within Minamoto no Yoritomo's Guardian Spirit.
achievements.summary: Defeat Minamoto no Yoritomo in Frozen City, Blazing Tree and destroy the Crucinite inside his Guardian Spirit.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Frozen City, Blazing Tree}, the Heian finale, and defeat @enemy{Minamoto no Yoritomo}.

achievements.description: Destroy the Crucinite harbored within Himiko's Guardian Spirit.
achievements.summary: Defeat the boss Kusanagi in The Spirit Tree Village and destroy the Crucinite inside Himiko's Guardian Spirit.

steps.text: Complete @loc{The Spirit Tree Village}, which opens Antiquity, and defeat @enemy{Kusanagi}.

achievements.description: Destroy the Crucinite harbored within Tokugawa Yoshinobu's Guardian Spirit.
achievements.summary: Defeat Okita Soji and Tokugawa Yoshinobu in Scion of the Gods and destroy the Crucinite inside Yoshinobu's Guardian Spirit.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Scion of the Gods}, Bakumatsu's second Crucible, and defeat @enemy{Okita Soji} and @enemy{Tokugawa Yoshinobu}.

achievements.description: Destroy the Crucinite harbored within Hiruko.
achievements.summary: Defeat the last boss Hiruko in A Sinister End and destroy the Crucinite within Hiruko.

steps.text: Complete @loc{A Sinister End}, the game's closing mission, and defeat @enemy{Hiruko}.

achievements.description: Be appointed the third shogun of the Edo Shogunate.
achievements.summary: Finish the closing mission A Sinister End to be appointed the third shogun.

guide.context: The achievement unlocks during the ending sequence that plays after Hiruko falls.

steps.text: Complete @loc{A Sinister End} and watch the ending.

achievements.description: Learned a Martial Art from a Crucible weapon for the first time.
achievements.summary: Max out the familiarity of a Crucible Weapon to learn its Crucible Art.

guide.context: Crucible Weapons are dropped by enemies inside Crucibles, and their inventory icon carries a red skull. Reaching maximum familiarity permanently teaches that weapon's Crucible Art.

steps.text: Obtain a @item{Crucible Weapon} from enemies inside a Crucible.
Equip it and keep killing enemies until its familiarity bar, shown in blue in the inventory, fills completely.

achievements.description: Defeated 10 enemies with a Strong Attack or a Martial Art enhanced via Arts Proficiency.
achievements.summary: Land the killing blow 10 times using an empowered Strong Attack or Martial Art while in Samurai Style.

guide.context: In Samurai Style the blue circle at the bottom-right fills as you attack. Once it is full, your next strong attack is empowered and glows blue.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Samurai Style}, attack enemies until the blue circle at the bottom-right is full.
Weaken an enemy with light attacks, then finish it with the glowing strong attack or an empowered Martial Art; repeat for 10 kills.

achievements.description: Defeated 10 enemies with Ninjutsu.
achievements.summary: Kill 10 enemies with Ninjutsu while in Ninja Style.

guide.context: Ninjutsu covers the ranged options in Ninja Style, such as Shuriken, Flames, and Bombs. Landing melee hits recharges your Ninjutsu.

steps.text: Press @mechanic{R2} to swap from Samurai Style into @mechanic{Ninja Style}.
Finish off 10 enemies with any @mechanic{Ninjutsu}; flying insects fall to two Shuriken.

achievements.description: Successfully activated Burst Break 10 times.
achievements.summary: Interrupt 10 red glowing enemy attacks with a Burst Break.

guide.context: Burst Break timing is strict: pressing too early or too late makes the counter fail. Aim for roughly half a second before the attack connects. Large enemies and bosses use red glowing attacks often.

steps.text: Wait for an enemy to charge a @warn{red glowing attack}.
Press @mechanic{R2} just before the attack lands to interrupt it; repeat until you have 10 successful Burst Breaks.

achievements.description: Successfully activated a Guardian Spirit Skill Burst Break for the first time.
achievements.summary: Interrupt a red glowing enemy attack with a charged Guardian Spirit Skill Burst Break.

guide.context: Defeating Takeda Shingen in A Fiery Invasion unlocks the Guardian Spirit Skill Burst Break. Charge the skill by landing attacks; a circle lights up beside your health bar while it is ready.

steps.text: Progress to @loc{A Fiery Invasion} and defeat @enemy{Takeda Shingen} to unlock the @mechanic{Guardian Spirit Skill Burst Break}.
Charge the skill with attacks, then hold @mechanic{L1} and press @mechanic{R2} just before a red glowing attack lands.

achievements.description: Used a Summoning Seal to summon a yokai for the first time.
achievements.summary: Use a Summoning Seal granted by an equipped Soul Core to summon a yokai.

guide.context: A Soul Core becomes usable only after it has been purified at a Shrine without dying. If a warning says the Soul Core cannot be used, defeat Crucible Wraiths and collect more until one is usable.

steps.text: Pick up a @item{Soul Core}, the red-heart drop, and reach a Shrine alive to purify it.
Open @mechanic{Manage Soul Core}, then @mechanic{Onmyo Box}, then @mechanic{Yang Position}, and equip the Soul Core there.
Assign the resulting @item{Summoning Seal} to a shortcut and use it once against an enemy.

achievements.description: Unlocked all named shrines and Bodhisattva Statues.
achievements.summary: Activate all 156 named Shrines and Bodhisattva Statues.

guide.context: Walk close enough to each one for its map icon to change from dark to bright green. Some of these fast-travel points exist only inside Missions and are not tracked on the open-world map, though they sit on the main path.

steps.text: Visit every named @loc{Shrine} and @loc{Bodhisattva Statue} across all regions and inside every Mission until the tracker reads 156/156.

achievements.description: Raised your Exploration Level to 4 in any area.
achievements.summary: Raise the Exploration Level of any region to 4.

guide.context: Exploration Level rises as you find collectibles in a region. Enemy Bases, Lesser Crucibles, and Myths give the largest boosts, and reaching Level 4 marks all remaining collectibles on the map.

steps.text: Explore one region, find collectibles, clear Enemy Bases, and complete Myths until its @mechanic{Exploration Level} reaches 4; check progress by opening the map and pressing @mechanic{R2} on the region.

achievements.description: Defeated a master for the first time.
achievements.summary: Defeat a master for the first time.

guide.context: No friendly Revenant or other companion may join a master duel. Masters show up on the map as Exploration Level rises; one early example is Taigen Sessai at Lake Hamana in Warring States.

steps.text: Travel to any @loc{master encounter} on the map and win the duel.

achievements.description: Defeated all masters.
achievements.summary: Defeat all 13 masters.

guide.context: Masters appear on the map as Exploration Level rises, and each is a solo duel where companions are not allowed. Anything missed can be fought later.

steps.text: Defeat all 13 @loc{masters} across Warring States, Heian, Antiquity, and Bakumatsu.

achievements.description: Activated all set bonus effects for an equipment set.
achievements.summary: Equip a complete equipment set and activate all of its set bonus effects.

guide.context: Set pieces list their set name in green in the item stats. Some sets consist of five armor pieces plus a sixth weapon or accessory piece, and the full bonus requires every listed piece.

steps.text: Collect every piece of one equipment set, checking green set names in your inventory.
Wear all pieces of that set at once so every set bonus turns active.

achievements.description: Forged an item for the first time.
achievements.summary: Forge any item at the Eternal Rift blacksmith.

guide.context: The Eternal Rift hub, and with it the blacksmith, unlocks after the first Crucible. You can return there at any time from the map screen.

steps.text: Progress the story past the first Crucible to unlock the @loc{Eternal Rift}.
Talk to the @npc{blacksmith}, choose @mechanic{Disassemble} on unwanted gear for materials, then choose @mechanic{Forge} and make any item.

achievements.description: Performed a Soul Match for the first time.
achievements.summary: Use the Eternal Rift blacksmith to complete a single Soul Match.

guide.context: Soul Match opens up after you finish Myth A Fierce Flame. That Myth begins automatically in The Hamamatsu Incident, right after you first leave the Eternal Rift, so it cannot be missed.

steps.text: Complete Myth @mechanic{A Fierce Flame} to unlock @mechanic{Soul Extraction} and @mechanic{Soul Match} at the blacksmith.
Choose @mechanic{Soul Extraction} and sacrifice unwanted low-level equipment to obtain @item{Soul Ore}.
Choose @mechanic{Soul Match}, select a piece of equipment, and raise its level to finish the match.

achievements.description: Remodeled a piece of equipment for the first time.
achievements.summary: Remodel one piece of equipment at the Eternal Rift blacksmith.

guide.context: Remodeling unlocks with the blacksmith after the first Crucible and changes one attribute on a piece of gear.

steps.text: At the @loc{Eternal Rift}, talk to the @npc{blacksmith}, choose @mechanic{Remodel}, pick any item and attribute, then confirm.

achievements.description: Pet a Chijiko for the first time.
achievements.summary: Pet any Chijiko.

guide.context: Chijiko are small yokai that hide in the open world. Shoot one to make it show itself, then move up and pet it.

steps.text: Find a @enemy{Chijiko}, shoot it to make it appear, and @mechanic{pet} it.

achievements.description: Pet all Chijiko.
achievements.summary: Pet all 43 Chijiko.

guide.context: There are 43 Chijiko. Their locations are automatically marked on the map once a region reaches Exploration Level 4.

steps.text: Find and pet all 43 @enemy{Chijiko} across every region.

achievements.description: Used all methods to traverse Spirit Veins.
achievements.summary: Use every type of Spirit Vein traversal.

guide.context: This does not require unlocking every Spirit Vein, only using one of each traversal method. Every Guardian Spirit needed to use a Spirit Vein type is an automatic story unlock, so the achievement comes naturally while collecting.

steps.text: Traverse at least one Spirit Vein of every type using the @mechanic{Guardian Spirits} earned from the story.

achievements.description: Completed three missions during Expeditions or with NPCs. (Includes Acolytes.)
achievements.summary: Complete three missions with NPC allies or other players.

guide.context: Acolytes are summoned from Blue Graves and appear even when offline; the mission must be finished while the Acolyte is alive. Named NPC helpers in some Myths and Sub Missions also count. Online players can be recruited at any Shrine through Co-Op > Expeditions.

steps.text: Summon an @npc{Acolyte} from a @loc{Blue Grave} or start @mechanic{Co-Op Expeditions} at a Shrine.
Finish three missions with the ally alive or with other players.

achievements.description: Traded a furball with a Scampuss in the Eternal Rift for the first time.
achievements.summary: Give one Scampuss Furball to the large Scampuss in the Eternal Rift.

guide.context: The Eternal Rift unlocks after the first Crucible. Scampusses are the rolling cats in the open world; petting and catching one yields a Furball.

steps.text: Pet and catch any @enemy{Scampuss} to obtain a @item{Scampuss Furball}.
Return to the @loc{Eternal Rift}, talk to the large @npc{Scampuss} on the side of the hub, and give it one Furball.

achievements.description: Bathed in first hot spring.
achievements.summary: Bathe in any Hot Spring.

steps.text: Find a @loc{Hot Spring} in the open world and interact with it to bathe.

achievements.description: Bathe in every hot spring.
achievements.summary: Bathe in all 26 Hot Springs.

guide.context: There are 26 Hot Springs across the regions, and their locations are marked on the map once Exploration Level 4 is reached in each area.

steps.text: Find and bathe in all 26 @loc{Hot Springs}.

achievements.description: Guided all Kodama home.
achievements.summary: Guide all 92 Kodama home to their Shrines.

guide.context: Kodama are the small spirits that return to a Shrine when found; each one increases the Elixirs replenished at that Shrine, and they are marked on the map at Exploration Level 4.

steps.text: Find all 92 @item{Kodama} and send each one back to its Shrine.

achievements.description: Prayed at all of the Six Jizo.
achievements.summary: Pray at all 20 Six Jizo statues.

guide.context: There are 20 Six Jizo monuments in the open world, shown on the map once a region reaches Exploration Level 4.

steps.text: Visit and pray at all 20 @loc{Six Jizo} statues.

achievements.description: Pet all Scampusses.
achievements.summary: Pet all 16 Scampusses.

guide.context: Scampusses are the friendly cats that roll around the open world; you must follow each one until it lets you pet it.

steps.text: Find and pet all 16 @enemy{Scampusses}.

achievements.description: Purified a Soul Core for the first time.
achievements.summary: Purify a Soul Core at a Shrine.

guide.context: Soul Cores are red-heart drops from some yokai, and they are lost if you die before reaching a Shrine.

steps.text: Pick up a @item{Soul Core} from a defeated enemy, then stay alive until you reach a @loc{Shrine} to purify it.

achievements.description: Captured an enemy base for the first time.
achievements.summary: Capture any Enemy Base.

guide.context: Enemy Bases are locations filled with enemies; clearing every enemy inside captures the base.

steps.text: Enter any @loc{Enemy Base} and defeat all of its enemies.

achievements.description: Captured all enemy bases.
achievements.summary: Capture all 26 Enemy Bases.

guide.context: Some Enemy Bases only appear during specific Myths or Main Missions and are not visible otherwise, so complete all Myths and story missions to reveal every base.

steps.text: Clear all 26 @loc{Enemy Bases} across every region.

achievements.description: Purified a Lesser Crucible for the first time.
achievements.summary: Purify a Lesser Crucible.

guide.context: A Lesser Crucible is a combat challenge that ends with a Crucible Spike; destroying the spike removes the Crucible and purifies it.

steps.text: Clear any @loc{Lesser Crucible} by beating every enemy wave, then break the @loc{Crucible Spike}.

achievements.description: Purified all Lesser Crucibles.
achievements.summary: Purify all 23 Lesser Crucibles.

guide.context: There are 23 Lesser Crucibles, marked on the map once the region reaches Exploration Level 4.

steps.text: Complete and purify all 23 @loc{Lesser Crucibles}.

achievements.description: Defeat the Demon of Pride and glimpse Kunimatsu's emotions.
achievements.summary: Defeat the hidden boss Demon of Pride in Warring States > Iinoya and inspect the ghost that appears.

guide.context: The Demon of Pride shows up as a golden chest icon. Starting at Sengan Waterfall Shrine, take the Spirit Vein just north of it to reach the clearing where the boss waits. A Guardian Spirit earned later in the story is required, so return after making story progress. The boss does not scale with your level, which makes it much easier at a high level.

steps.text: In @loc{Warring States > Iinoya}, start at the @loc{Sengan Waterfall} Shrine, ride the Spirit Vein just north of it, and follow the path to the golden chest area.
Defeat the @enemy{Demon of Pride}, then speak to the ghost that fades in nearby.

achievements.description: Defeat the Demon of Envy and glimpse Kunimatsu's emotions.
achievements.summary: Defeat the hidden boss Demon of Envy in the cave above Anneibo Temple in Heian > Hachijo and inspect the ghost that appears.

guide.context: The Demon of Envy shows up as a golden chest icon. Starting at Anneibo Temple Shrine, face the shrine, turn left, climb the scaffolding, then drop into the hidden cave at the end of the path. The boss does not scale with your level.

steps.text: In @loc{Heian > Hachijo}, start at the @loc{Anneibo Temple} Shrine, turn left, climb the scaffolding, and drop into the hidden cave.
Defeat the @enemy{Demon of Envy}, then speak to the ghost that fades in nearby.

achievements.description: Defeat the Demon of Obsession and glimpse Kunimatsu's emotions.
achievements.summary: Defeat the hidden boss Demon of Obsession in Bakumatsu > Nijo Castle and inspect the ghost that appears.

guide.context: The Demon of Obsession shows up as a golden chest icon in the north-west of Nijo Castle. Reach it from the Mibu region: at Mibu Temple – Main Gate Shrine, drop off the hill that sits south of the golden chest icon.

steps.text: In @loc{Bakumatsu > Mibu}, start at the @loc{Mibu Temple – Main Gate} Shrine and drop off the hillside directly south of that gold chest marker.
Defeat the @enemy{Demon of Obsession}, then speak to the ghost that fades in nearby.

achievements.description: Recover the blacksmith's memory.
achievements.summary: Complete Myth Memories in the Blade by finding the 3 hidden swords.

guide.context: Talk to the blacksmith once you have entered Main Region 2 (Heian) and beaten Great Tengu in Sacred Mountain Defiled to start this Myth. Its objectives are marked on the map.

steps.text: Reach Main Region 2 (Heian) and beat @enemy{Great Tengu} in @loc{Sacred Mountain Defiled}, then talk to the @npc{blacksmith} to begin Myth @mechanic{Memories in the Blade}.
Find the 3 hidden swords using the marked objectives and complete the Myth.

achievements.description: In Black Feather Sanctuary, drive out all crows from Matsuo-taisha Shrine and defeat Otoroshi.
achievements.summary: During Black Feather Sanctuary, drive off all 3 Torii-gate crows with ranged shots, then defeat Otoroshi.

guide.context: The crows only need to take damage and vanish, so any bow or gun works. The mission is unmissable and sits as the westernmost yellow marker in Heian's Sagano sub-region, replayable from Shrine > Battle Scrolls > Heian > Black Feather Sanctuary.

steps.text: Right after the first Shrine, shoot the first @enemy{crow} on the Torii Gate ahead of you.
After the second Shrine and the ice cave, shoot the second @enemy{crow}.
After the third Shrine, entering the larger temple area, shoot the third @enemy{crow}.
Fight your way to the mission's final area and defeat @enemy{Otoroshi} to unlock the achievement.

achievements.description: In A Sinister End, repel all of Murakumo's attacks.
achievements.summary: In A Sinister End, shoot the bird Murakumo each time it appears until it flees for the last time.

guide.context: Murakumo is the bird that casts lightning from a distance and then flies off, reappearing at several points through the mission. Being hit by its lightning does not void the achievement, and it usually unlocks even for players who never shoot it; the final encounter happens during the Death Veil fight. Replay the mission from the Battle Scroll if needed.

steps.text: Each time @enemy{Murakumo} appears, shoot it so it retreats.
Continue to the @loc{Death Veil} fight and let the bird flee for the last time to unlock the achievement.

achievements.description: Bathe with Himiko in Dark Roots, then recall Naotora's incident in Apparition of Ryotan Temple.
achievements.summary: Share the Dark Roots hot spring with Himiko, then use the hot spring during the replay of Apparition of Ryotan Temple.

guide.context: The order matters: Dark Roots must come first, with The Apparition of Ryotan Temple second. Both are replayed through Shrine > Battle Scrolls, and the achievement fires during the second visit when Himiko speaks a unique line.

steps.text: Replay @loc{Dark Roots} in Antiquity and, near the end before the boss, use the Hot Spring found at the bottom of the left-hand stairs once the last elevator has run; wait for @npc{Himiko} to finish speaking, then complete the mission.

From a Shrine, open @mechanic{Battle Scrolls}, choose @loc{The Apparition of Ryotan Temple} under Warring States, drop down a roof to the backyard pond, and use the Hot Spring tucked behind a @loc{Nurikabe} wall; wait for the achievement.

achievements.description: In Seeking Rare Yokai, satisfy Toriyama Sekien with a painting of Kusanagi.
achievements.summary: Complete Myth Seeking Rare Yokai by painting Himiko's Guardian Spirit Kusanagi.

guide.context: Seeking Rare Yokai is one of the two hidden Myths and sits in the final region Bakumatsu. It only becomes available once the Heian region's Yokai Horde Picture Scroll Myth is done.

steps.text: Finish the Heian Myth @mechanic{Yokai Horde Picture Scroll}.
Complete Myth @mechanic{Seeking Rare Yokai} in Bakumatsu, including talking to Himiko and drawing a painting of @item{Kusanagi} for @npc{Toriyama Sekien}.

achievements.description: Help Tatsumaro the Dung Lover connect with Takechiyo.
achievements.summary: Give 30 Dung Balls to Tatsumaro in the Eternal Rift.

guide.context: A Noble Dung Ball is worth 2 regular Dung Balls. Dung Balls drop randomly from enemies and turn up on corpses; a reliable farm is Warring States > Tokaido > Shrine: Cape Cavern, where wasps respawn whenever you fast travel back to the shrine.

steps.text: Complete Myth @mechanic{Putrid Paradise} in @loc{Heian > Hachijo} to make Tatsumaro appear in the Eternal Rift.
Take the ladder behind the blacksmith down into the @loc{Eternal Rift} cave to find @npc{Tatsumaro}.
Gather @item{Dung Balls} and hand over 30 total, counting each Noble Dung Ball as 2.

achievements.description: Complete veteran missions with Yagyu Munenori and Hattori Hanzo.
achievements.summary: Complete the Novice, Adept, and Veteran missions for both Yagyu Munenori and Hattori Hanzo.

guide.context: The Novice missions open in Main Region 1 (Warring States) once the first Crucible is done, and the Adept missions appear on entering Main Region 2 (Heian). Veteran missions show up in Main Region 4 (Bakumatsu) as soon as you receive A New Era. Each Veteran duel forces a style: face Yagyu in Samurai Style and Hattori in Ninja Style.

steps.text: Return to the @loc{Eternal Rift} and clear @npc{Yagyu Munenori} and @npc{Hattori Hanzo}'s @mechanic{Novice} missions.
On entering Heian, clear both masters' @mechanic{Adept} missions.
Once you reach Bakumatsu with @loc{A New Era}, talk to both masters and clear their @mechanic{Veteran} missions from Shrine > @mechanic{Battle Scrolls}.

achievements.description: Defeat Yagyu Jubei and reach an amicable agreement.
achievements.summary: Defeat the DLC boss Yagyu Jubei in Edo Castle and reach an amicable agreement.

guide.context: Yagyu Jubei is the first boss of the Hell Rising DLC. Beating him is mandatory for the DLC story and opens the way to the Kanda region.

steps.text: Play the Hell Rising story in @loc{Edo Castle} until @enemy{Yagyu Jubei} blocks the path.
Defeat @enemy{Yagyu Jubei} and follow the following scene to the amicable agreement.

achievements.description: Defeat Kanai Hanbei at Chokodo.
achievements.summary: Beat Kanai Hanbei to finish the DLC Mission Menace Lurking within Chokodo.

guide.context: Kanai Hanbei is the last boss of the Koishikawa region and is mandatory for progressing to Hongo Yushima.

steps.text: Progress the Hell Rising story to the Mission @loc{Menace Lurking within Chokodo}.
Defeat @enemy{Kanai Hanbei} to clear the mission.

achievements.description: Defeat Yui Shosetsu and cleanse the Crucible at Dokanyama.
achievements.summary: Defeat Yui Shosetsu and cleanse the Ueno Crucible at Dokanyama.

guide.context: Yui Shosetsu waits at the finish of the Ueno Crucible, named Dokanyama.

steps.text: Enter the @loc{Ueno Crucible} at Dokanyama during the Hell Rising story.
Defeat @enemy{Yui Shosetsu} and cleanse the Crucible.

achievements.description: Uncover the secrets of the Shinkage style at the Ravine Training Ground.
achievements.summary: Complete Myth Way of the Yagyu by uncovering the Shinkage style secrets at the Ravine Training Ground.

guide.context: Myth Way of the Yagyu is unlocked by completing the DLC's first Main Mission, Crucible Once Again. It requires defeating the Giant Toad boss inside the Munenori mansion in eastern Kanda.

steps.text: Complete the DLC Main Mission @loc{Crucible Once Again} to unlock Myth @mechanic{Way of the Yagyu}.
Enter the @npc{Munenori} mansion in eastern @loc{Kanda} and defeat the @enemy{Giant Toad}.
Finish the Myth objectives at the @loc{Ravine Training Ground} to uncover the Shinkage style secrets.

achievements.description: Defeated all masters in Hell Rising.
achievements.summary: Defeat all masters in the Hell Rising DLC.

guide.context: The DLC adds its own set of masters. If none are skipped, the achievement unlocks when the Ueno Master is defeated.

steps.text: Defeat every @loc{DLC master}, finishing with the @loc{Ueno Master}.

achievements.description: Completed all Myths in Hell Rising.
achievements.summary: Complete all Myths in the Hell Rising DLC.

guide.context: The DLC contains ten Myths. If none are skipped, the achievement unlocks on defeating Jakotsu-baba and completing Myth Waterside Temptation.

steps.text: Complete all 10 Hell Rising Myths, including @mechanic{Waterside Temptation}.

achievements.description: Guided all Kodama home and pet all Chijiko and Scampusses in Hell Rising.
achievements.summary: Guide all Kodama home and pet all Chijiko and Scampusses in the Hell Rising DLC.

guide.context: This combines the DLC's Kodama, Chijiko, and Scampuss collectibles. Reaching Exploration Level 4 in the DLC areas marks the remaining ones on the map.

steps.text: Guide every @item{Kodama} home and pet every @enemy{Chijiko} and @enemy{Scampuss} in the Hell Rising areas.

achievements.description: Learned all learnable Martial Arts for hoko & shields and ninja hoko & shields in Hell Rising.
achievements.summary: Learn every learnable hoko & shield and ninja hoko & shield Martial Art in the Hell Rising DLC.

guide.context: Open every node in the hoko & shield and ninja hoko & shield skill trees. Some skills are learned by maxing the familiarity of Crucible weapons rather than by spending skill points.

steps.text: Unlock all nodes in the @mechanic{hoko & shield} and @mechanic{ninja hoko & shield} Martial Arts and Ninjutsu skill trees.
Max the familiarity of any Crucible weapons that teach the remaining learnable Martial Arts.

achievements.description: Purified Hundred Demon Realms Picture Scrolls five times.
achievements.summary: Purify 5 Hundred Demon Realms Picture Scrolls by completing their gauntlet battles.

guide.context: Picture Scrolls drop randomly from enemies, especially inside the Crucible, and farming the Ueno area is efficient. Each scroll unlocks an automatically generated wave battle that must be won to purify it.

steps.text: Obtain 5 @item{Hundred Demon Realms Picture Scrolls} as enemy drops.
At a Shrine open @mechanic{Battle Scrolls}, start each scroll's gauntlet, defeat every wave, and purify 5 scrolls.

achievements.description: Nullified an enemy's Curse for the first time.
achievements.summary: Nullify an enemy's Curse by depleting its stamina and landing a Grapple on Enlightened One's Journey.

guide.context: The Enlightened One's Journey difficulty requires Hell Rising and becomes available only after you clear Shogun's Journey, so it is effectively New Game+2. On that difficulty certain enemies carry a Curse buff that does not exist on lower settings.

steps.text: Finish the game on @mechanic{Shogun's Journey} to unlock @mechanic{Enlightened One's Journey}, then start it.
Find a @warn{cursed enemy}, drain its stamina, then land a @mechanic{Grapple} to strip the Curse.

achievements.description: Completed Mountain Keep in the Storm's Eye with three or more different NPC companions (excluding Acolytes).
achievements.summary: Complete the Hell Rising mission Mountain Keep in the Storm's Eye with three or more different NPC companions, not counting Acolytes.

guide.context: Acolytes do not count. Use the named NPC companions who join during the DLC story, and complete the mission with three or more different ones across your attempts.

steps.text: Play the DLC mission @loc{Mountain Keep in the Storm's Eye} with different named @npc{NPC companions} until three distinct companions have been used and the mission is completed.

achievements.description: Use the powerful winds in the Dokanyama Crucible to defeat an enemy (excluding online play).
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with the whirlwind device in the Dokanyama Crucible during solo play.

guide.context: The whirlwind device is found east of the Bodhisattva Statue at Dokanyama – Approach. A ghost-type enemy is nearby; weaken it from range without killing it, then bait it into the wind. Kills in online play do not count.

steps.text: Inside the @loc{Dokanyama Crucible}, head east from the @loc{Dokanyama – Approach Bodhisattva Statue} to find the @loc{whirlwind device}.
Lower the health of a nearby @enemy{ghost-type enemy} with ranged attacks, without killing it, then bait it into the device so the wind finishes it.

achievements.description: Complete Mountain Keep in the Storm's Eye on Enlightened One's Journey.
achievements.summary: Complete the Hell Rising mission Mountain Keep in the Storm's Eye on the Enlightened One's Journey difficulty.

guide.context: Enlightened One's Journey requires Hell Rising and becomes available only after you clear Shogun's Journey, so it is effectively New Game+2. The mission can be replayed through Shrine > Battle Scrolls.

steps.text: Finish the game on @mechanic{Shogun's Journey} to unlock @mechanic{Enlightened One's Journey}.
On Enlightened One's Journey, replay the DLC mission @loc{Mountain Keep in the Storm's Eye} from Shrine > @mechanic{Battle Scrolls} and complete it.
